# Deny-listed patterns (extended regex, one per line) for scripts/ci/check-private-references.sh.
# This repository is public: links/references that resolve to private DSB repositories or
# internal-only hosts must never appear in tracked files, commit messages or PR descriptions.
#
# Private GitHub org (all repos in it are private):
github\.com[:/]dsb-infra
dsb-infra\.github\.io
#
# Bare owner/repo, the form `gh`, `uses:` and api.github.com URLs use — pasting a command's
# output or an error message is the easy way to leak one. Pointing INTO a private repo is what
# this guard prevents; the org name alone in prose is fine and appears in the design docs.
dsb-infra/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+
